notes.title: Release!
notes.notes: Discover the disturbing mysteries that surround the archipelago, in a grueling fight against dangers and mutated creatures.

notes.title: Smarter and faster! Also available for Linux!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107173/dffb331b2ae1e605d8897224047da14ac56bb65d.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]This new update includes:[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] a very broad review of software architecture
[*] a new level design, which aims to offer a denser and richer experience
[*] of the smartest NPCs
[*] structural adaptations to accommodate new and interesting updates!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107173/d624b21e137059de98f76b0897f653f7b9f85d22.jpg[/img]

Several bugs have also been fixed to optimize the user experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107173/784f69bc749db7839a432074aeee4cb9bec04db2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107173/f094ad89971b7ef3d88f9ac623a1a57c101b4a80.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Apocalyptic driver update
notes.notes:
An update that contains many bug-fixes and a generic improvement of the frame-rate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107173/0ebbe41b7448fe8bfb48f85f4481acce5ab8bdaa.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Vehicles now have a different sound for each engine type.
[*] Vehicle hud is more immersive.
[*] It is now possible to encounter various faction checkpoints on the streets.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107173/abee5591f96ac41fa40d04bdc41b2a4d334d6554.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107173/5fc72140d697474bc6d3f350f4cb78e24eb583a0.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
UPDATE 0.7
Fixed minor bugs, introduced a static spawn system for vehicles, introduced system for crafting weapons for vehicles from the interaction menu, increased animal spawn zones.
